note: P shares a lilac/serif card feel and similar curve families, but the buttons differ (white glass pill, pastel glow, purple-pink gradient on a dark hero, sparkle pastel) and the pages range from booking card to plans to dark landing to newsletter. Q uses near-identical bezier sets and the same dark indigo filled pill in all four, with only the page context (newsletter, dark studio, waitlist hero, observatory) changing.
